answer: Histories are stored in pigment, checked in horizon, and sable reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 8 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 828 identities would post 503 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
